data.one_liner: Puts a semi-transparent design image over the developed layout to compare original design and code.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to overlay a semi-transparent design mockup image on top of their Flutter widget hierarchy. Provides controls for opacity, positioning, and scaling to easily align and compare the layout against the intended design.
use_when: You are implementing UI designs and need to ensure exact visual fidelity
You want to compare your Flutter app layout directly against a designer's mockup
avoid_when: In production builds where design overlays are not needed
When building non-visual backend or utility packages
strengths: Supports customizable initial opacity, bottom positioning, and offset
Includes an extended constructor for custom image providers
weaknesses: Primarily a development tool and should be removed or disabled in production
data.setup_notes: Add the package to dependencies and ensure design images are included in your pubspec.yaml assets.

alternatives.name: device_preview
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to preview your app across different screen sizes, orientations, and text scales rather than just overlaying a design image.
